title: Privacy Bias in Language Models: A Contextual Integrity-based Auditing Metric

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to Contextual Integrity (CI) vignettes on a Likert scale to measure the acceptability of specific information flows, and calculating the deviation (privacy bias delta) from expected societal privacy norms or crowdsourced expectations using a multi-prompt assessment to account for prompt sensitivity.
